items.title: Natural Gas Market Splinters as Southeast, Appalachia Push Higher
items.summary: Natural gas spot prices strengthened across the Southeast and Appalachia Wednesday, bucking broader regional declines and a steep futures sell-off fueled by forecasts for exceptionally mild weather through early November.

items.title: Woodside’s Louisiana LNG Buildout 32% Complete, but Steel Supply Risks Linger
items.summary: The first liquefaction train at Woodside Energy’s Louisiana LNG project is 41% complete, the company announced Wednesday.

items.title: Natural Gas Sell-Off Masks a Troubling Storage Shortfall
items.summary: November natural gas futures tumbled below $2.800/MMBtu Wednesday ahead of a closely watched storage report, even as sharply depleted South Central salt inventories raised concerns about the market’s vulnerability to unexpected winter demand.

items.title: US Feedgas Demand Surges, With Europe Claiming Bulk of Cargoes
items.summary: US LNG feedgas demand rebounded Wednesday, climbing about 1.3 Bcf/d from Tuesday, according to Entropic Analytics’ US Daily Supply & Demand Report.

items.title: Natural Gas Prices Crater as Weather Demand Drops
items.summary: New York Mercantile Exchange natural gas futures continued this week’s slump through midday on Wednesday as weather forecasts trended further into bearish territory.

items.title: Saudi Gas Development Anchors Halliburton’s International Growth Push

items.title: Alberta’s Natural Gas Dominance in Focus as Province Votes to Remain in Canada
items.summary: Following a landmark referendum in which Albertans voted to remain part of Canada, Prime Minister Mark Carney emphasized the province’s pivotal role in unlocking the nation’s potential as a global energy superpower.

items.title: Why East Region Natural Gas Storage Could Flip to Year/Year Deficit
items.summary: Natural gas stored in the East could shift to a deficit relative to 2025 with Thursday’s government inventory print, potentially reflecting the repercussions of a pipeline leak that curtailed mid-October production in Appalachia.

items.title: From Mexico to Argentina, AI Data Centers Fuel New Natural Gas Demand Prospects
items.summary: Latin American entrepreneurs are eyeing natural gas to support a growing data center buildout to support artificial intelligence (AI) across the region.
